name: clawd-buddy
description: Animated pixel mascot Clawd above the prompt: reacts to Claude's work, waiting times, idle time, time of day, the mouse and a mood that builds up over the session.

nightStart.title: Night starts (hour)
nightStart.description: From this hour (0 to 23) he gets tired when idle and falls asleep.

nightEnd.title: Night ends (hour)
nightEnd.description: Night time lasts until this hour (0 to 23). If it is before the start, the night spans midnight.

idleSeconds.title: Idle time before pastimes (seconds)
idleSeconds.description: How long without activity before he passes the time.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Only the base pose and calm variants, no pastimes.

side.title: Position in the band
side.description: Right or left above the prompt.

birthday.title: Birthday (DD.MM.)
birthday.description: On this day he celebrates with you (cake, party hat). Empty = off.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.
